from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,hashlib
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.tools.t02_export_parallel import child_outcome
name="t02_export_test_selected05_six03"
data,ref=audited_result("results/"+name+".json")
cfg,m=data["config"],data["metrics"]
assert data["_meta"]["end"] and m["all_units_ended"] is True and m["cleanup_errors"]==[] and m["errors"]==[]
rows=m["units"];assert [v["unit_index"] for v in rows]==list(range(6))
identity={k:cfg[k] for k in ("pbs_jobid","cuda_visible_devices","cpu_affinity","scratch","node")}

 child,source=audited_result(row["result_path"])
 assert all(source[k]==row["source"][k] for k in ("file","sha256","metrics_sha256"))
 proof=child_outcome(row,child,identity,row["command"],row["entry"])
 assert all(row[k]==v for k,v in proof.items())
 for pair in proof["original_pairs"]:
  counts[pair["status"]]+=1
  out.append({"unit_index":row["unit_index"],"pair_id":pair["pair_id"],"status":pair["status"],"error":pair.get("error"),"exit_code":proof["producer_exit_code"],"export_checks_complete":proof["export_checks_complete"],"source":source})
print(json.dumps({"parent":ref,"parent_exit":data["_meta"]["exit_code"],"status_counts":dict(counts),"outcomes":out,"cache_matches_live":None,"downstream_allowed":False,"scope":"Original sealed export outcomes and scheduling provenance rechecked; no native or cache rerun and no error-key reset"},sort_keys=True))
